prompt:

2. source_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one complete high-fidelity desktop website design comp for The Lobby. Landscape 3:2, approximately 1440 by 960. The actual website fills the image edge to edge. The whole compact welcome and footer are visible. No browser window, TV, computer, device mockup, desk, presentation board or separate screenshot floating inside an illustration.

SURFACE STRUCTURE: The page itself has the visual rhythm of a warm local co-op title menu with exactly one main entry action. A small "The Lobby" identity link sits quietly in the top-left margin. The center of the open matte field is anchored by custom substantial rounded title lettering: "Welcome to" on a smaller line, then the very large words "The Lobby". Together these two lines are the single heading "Welcome to The Lobby". The supporting sentence sits clearly beneath the title. Below it is one broad tactile menu-shaped button reading "Sign in", the sole primary choice. Place the invitation guidance immediately below this button. A small, charming, explicitly cartoon robot host stands near the lower-right corner of the button, welcoming the visitor with one friendly open-hand gesture. It is a supporting detail, never a large separate illustration or half-page mascot. Quiet footer links share a stable lower baseline and are fully visible.

VISUAL WORLD: Local Co-op. Sophisticated contemporary illustration and type recalling the friendly title screens of couch multiplayer games, but this is an ordinary website welcome for a shared place. A matte seafoam #74CEBF field covers most of the page. Deep navy #233552 supplies the confident title, text, and precise control outlines. Custard #FFD983 carries the large primary menu shape, with a restrained coral #FF845C offset lower edge for tactile depth. Keep saturation warm and intentional, use subtle print grain in the large colour fields, and generous inviting negative space. One broad understated navy lower-ground shape can support the footer, keeping its text pale custard or seafoam and highly legible. No gradient mesh, neon, realistic lighting, glass panels, stock imagery, or stereotyped SaaS decorations.

THE DOMINANT MOVE: Oversized, beautifully authored, rounded substantial title letters and a single confident menu action create a real title-screen composition at page scale. Softly squared corners and carefully drawn heavy letterforms, slightly playful proportions, restrained thick navy contours, and shallow tactile depth. The title is readable, not a complex ornamental logo. Let the main title own roughly the central half of the viewport, with the single sign-in control unmistakable below it. A few large quiet edge shapes in the same colour fields support this composition without becoming props or a pattern. Do not make a generic copy-left/image-right landing page, a row of equal cards, or an app catalog. This is one clear title menu on one open illustrated surface.

CARTOON HOST: One small fictional robot, around 140–170px tall at this page size, drawn as an original flat editorial cartoon. Rounded coral body, navy face panel with two simple friendly eyes, seafoam or custard limbs. Simple expressive adult-friendly character design and relaxed welcoming gesture. No real people, no realistic human face or skin, no celebrity resemblance, no Craig likeness, no photographic rendering, no copyrighted robot design. Do not let the character dominate the title or cover text or controls. Cross-age warmth, not preschool art. No controller, player avatar, game gear, weapon, score, badge, medal, collectible, emotion bubble or written character dialogue.

TYPE AND FUNCTION: Sharp semantic-looking webpage text throughout. The main words The Lobby should be about 150px equivalent; the Welcome to line about 46px; support sentence about 26px; sign-in label about 28px; guidance and footer around 17–18px. The Sign in control is a wide custard rounded rectangle with a dark navy border, a modest coral offset base, and a small simple right arrow. Nothing about it requires a keyboard or game controller. No press-key gate. No other primary buttons. All utility links look plainly clickable and remain quiet.

EXACT TEXT ONLY, each once in its assigned role:
Top-left site identity: "The Lobby"
Main heading across two lines: "Welcome to The Lobby"
Supporting sentence: "A shared place for family and friends."
Primary control: "Sign in"
Guidance below: "Access is by invitation."
Small lower-left footer link: "Schedule Downloader"
Adjacent footer explanation: "No sign-in needed"
Small lower-right footer link: "Privacy"
Do not add any other words, labels or facts. No player counts, avatars, friend status, game scores, pretend multiplayer activity, press-key instructions, controller requirement, start game, game inventory, tool catalog, sign-up, request-access, password fields, pricing, testimonials, copyright or dates. The robot is decorative and fictional; it must not imply a game feature. This complete welcome page invites people into their shared private place, with one quiet public utility.
